news.title: Higher Ed Groups Ask Congress to Reverse Rescissions Targeting International Education
news.summary_en: Nearly $70 million for foreign language and international education programs is at stake in the administration’s latest rescissions package, raising new questions about the future of congressionally approved funding.

news.title: New J-1 Visa Proposal Raises Concerns for International Students and Scholars
news.summary_en: The proposed rule would allow J-1 participation to end immediately after a visa is revoked, leaving international students and scholars with little opportunity to challenge the decision.
